"ZORK1 MARA ANTICIPATION WORRY AND PROTECTIVE INITIATIVE GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Mara Anticipation, Worry & Protective Initiative. Release
  1261 lets specific remembered danger alter future behavior before another
  injury: Mara can recognize the live risk, warn without waiting for a fall,
  truthfully prepare what she has, and remember whether the warning changed the
  player's later action. No generic worry meter or autonomous puzzle solver."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 HOSTILE ROOMS AND REACTIVE THREATS GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Hostile Rooms & Reactive Threats. Release 1262 adds an
  original treasure-guardian dragon and real hoard whose threat watches what the
  Adventurer actually does. Retreat, bargaining, bait and containment, and
  existing mine-fire smoke provide authored approaches without a boss HP layer."
